name: Alloys
description: Brass, Rose Gold, Sakura, and Steel

pages.title: Alloys
pages.text:
The Alloy Forge makes four alloys, shown on the next pages.

Recipes use the common ingot tags, so copper, zinc, gold, and iron from other mods work too.

pages.title: Brass
pages.text:
**3 copper ingots** and **1 zinc ingot** make 4 Brass Ingots.

See [Brass](entry://materials/brass) for its gear.

pages.title: Rose Gold
pages.text:
**3 gold ingots** and **1 copper ingot** make 2 Rose Gold Ingots.

See [Rose Gold](entry://materials/rose_gold) for its gear.

pages.title: Sakura
pages.text:
**1 iron ingot** and **4 pink petals** make 1 Sakura Ingot. Pink petals carpet the ground in cherry groves.

See [Sakura](entry://materials/sakura) for its gear.

pages.title: Steel
pages.text:
**1 iron ingot** and **2 coal or charcoal** make 1 Steel Ingot. It takes a little longer than the other alloys.

See [Steel](entry://materials/steel) for its gear.
